hooks.command: d="${CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR:-.}"; f="$d/.claude/hooks/guard-destructive.py"; [ -f "$f" ] || exit 0; for p in "$d/.venv/Scripts/python.exe" "$d/.venv/bin/python" python3 python; do command -v "$p" >/dev/null 2>&1 && exec "$p" "$f"; done; exit 0

jq -r '.tool_input.command // empty' | grep -q 'gh pr create' && echo '{"hookSpecificOutput":{"hookEventName":"PreToolUse","additionalContext":"post-branch reminder: you are ABOUT TO run gh pr create. Invoke the /post-branch skill FIRST, while the branch is still local-only, and fold its Documentation-updates section into this PR body rather than editing the body afterwards. Rationale (user decision 2026-08-06): these are private repos on the free tier, and a doc-sync commit pushed to an already-open PR re-runs the whole 5-check matrix - doing the sweep first is one CI run instead of two, with identical review signal. Its behaviour gate decides whether a docs sweep is warranted, so this is cheap even on a pure refactor. Do not skip phase 4 (MEMORY.md, 6-bullet cap; SoT reconcile; claims audit). Re-verifying PR state still runs LAST, after the PR exists. Advisory only - never blocking. Rationale: CLAUDE.md > Git Conventions."}}' || true
